title.narrative: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Cities Improvement Projects - Project Readiness Financing

description.narrative: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Cities Improvement Projects (KPCIP) will improve the quality of life of the residents of at least four cities, including Abbottabad, Kohat, Mardan, and Peshawar, directly benefitting about 3.5 million of urban population. The KPCIP will help selected cities improve their access to quality urban services through two interlinked outputs: (i) enhanced municipal infrastructure and public urban spaces, and (ii) strengthened institutional capacities and efficiency of provincial, municipal and city governments and urban service companies. The project readiness financing (PRF) will finance the preparation and engineering design of the KPCIP and possible future pipeline of urban projects in KPK. The PRF will ensure high project readiness of the KPCIP, thereby facilitating the timely and cost-effective achievement of the project outcomes.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Indicator Indicator: Due diligence for proposed project investments completed. Progress/Status: On track. Detailed Engineering design complete and sub-sectoral Master Plan prepared and approved by the Technical Committee. However, the same will be presented to the boards of the respective WSSCs and subsequently to the provincial cabinet of KP for approval and legislation. Actual value:
Output: Indicator Indicator: Capacity of executing and implementation agencies for PRF implementation improved. Progress/Status: Facility based training in Turkey completed in 2021.
Output: Indicator Indicator: Detailed engineering design and procurement support completed Progress/Status: Completed.

Output: Indicator Indicator: Strengthening service delivery standards, social inclusion, and financial sustainability of municipal bodies. Progress/Status: IRCB contract awarded in Nov 2020 and deliverable submission in process. The business models have been firmed up. In November the IRCB and the project team conducted a workshop with stakeholders for inputs on the BDO model. These are being incorporated and the BD document will be finalized by end of January 2024.
